pairs: For those who will be changed.
The One who reigns over Israel:
For you lead Joseph like a sheep.
The One who sits upon the cherubim:
so as to accomplish our salvation.
quousque irasceris super orationem servi tui?
how long will you be angry over the prayer of your servant?
How long will you feed us the bread of tears,
et potum dabis nobis in lacrimis in mensura?
and give us to drink a full measure of tears?
Posuisti nos in contradictionem vicinis nostris,
You have set us as a contradiction to our neighbors.
And our enemies have ridiculed us.
You have transferred a vineyard from Egypt.
You have cast out the Gentiles,
Dux itineris fuisti in conspectu ejus;
You were the leader of the journey in its sight.
and its branches covered the cedars of God.
Extendit palmites suos usque ad mare,
It extended its new branches even to the sea,
et usque ad flumen propagines ejus.
and its new seedlings even to the river.
So then, why have you destroyed its walls,
et vindemiant eam omnes qui prætergrediuntur viam?
so that all those who pass by the way gather its grapes?
The wild boar of the forest has trampled it,
et singularis ferus depastus est eam.
and a single wild beast has laid waste to it.
et perfice eam quam plantavit dextera tua,
and complete what your right hand has planted,
et super filium hominis quem confirmasti tibi.
and look upon the son of man, whom you have confirmed for yourself.
Whatever has been set on fire
and dug under will perish at the rebuke of your countenance.
Fiat manus tua super virum dexteræ tuæ,
Let your hand be over the man on your right,
et super filium hominis quem confirmasti tibi.
and over the son of man, whom you have confirmed for yourself.
For we do not depart from you,
And we will invoke your name.
